analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 45.9, entering oversold territory, continuing downtrend from 62.6 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened to 1.3282, down from 4.4471 five days ago. While the 5-day low of $343.39 rose relative to the 20-day low of $314.90, the 5-day high of $384.48 fell relative to the 20-day high of $384.48, forming a Lower High pattern. Below SMA20 at $348.23 and below the swing resistance of $349.00. ADX at 15.0 indicates a non-trending phase with potential for shock-like moves.
